title: Gary Stearman's Cessna escorted by a walnut-shaped UFO
place_text: flight from Lubbock, Texas to Dallas

tellings.quote: The voice said, "If you look to your left, you'll see a UFO."

plain: A man named Gary Stearman was flying a small Cessna plane from Lubbock, Texas to Dallas when, it is said, a voice told him, "If you look to your left, you'll see a UFO," and a walnut-shaped object then flew beside the plane as an escort. Tim Alberino, a guest on an episode about reported giants, tells Michels this as Stearman told it to him. Whose voice it was, the telling does not say, but if true it would mean someone knew the object was coming.
